summary.text: Izaah Knox is a Democratic state senator for Iowa Senate District 17 and has served in the Iowa Senate since 2023.

paragraphs.text: The Iowa Legislature's 2023 biography lists Knox as executive director of Urban Dreams, with Drake University degrees in journalism and education, born in 1977 in Iowa City, raised in Cedar Rapids and Seattle, and living in Des Moines.

According to the Iowa Senate Democrats' biography page, Knox previously worked as a community outreach consultant for Wellmark Blue Cross Blue Shield and as an adjunct and YouthBuild education coordinator at Des Moines Area Community College.
